content: We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule description. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to measure spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. Then analyze peaks for methyl groups. Let's call tool.
